titleEn: Maximum Number of Occurrences of a Substring
title: 子串的最大出现次数
summary: 在长度介于 minSize 与 maxSize、不同字符数不超 maxLetters 的子串中，返回某个子串的最大出现次数。
insight: 任何较长合法子串的每次出现都包含其长度 minSize 的前缀出现，且前缀不同字符不会更多；因此只需统计固定长度 minSize 的合法窗口。
pitfalls: 相同子串的重叠出现也计数
窗口不同字符数通过频次数组维护

solutions.title: 最小长度窗口频次
solutions.idea: 只统计固定 minSize 合法子串并取最高频次。
steps: 维护长度 minSize 的滑动窗口、26 频次与 distinct
每加入右字符，窗口过长时移除左字符并更新 distinct
窗口长度等于 minSize 且 distinct<=maxLetters 时对 substring 计数并更新 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int maxFreq(String s,int maxLetters,int minSize,int maxSize){int[] frequency=new int[26];int left=0,distinct=0,answer=0;Map<String,Integer> counts=new HashMap<>();for(int right=0;right<s.length();right++){if(frequency[s.charAt(right)-'a']++==0)distinct++;if(right-left+1>minSize){if(--frequency[s.charAt(left++)-'a']==0)distinct--;}if(right-left+1==minSize&&distinct<=maxLetters){String value=s.substring(left,right+1);int count=counts.getOrDefault(value,0)+1;counts.put(value,count);answer=Math.max(answer,count);}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxFreq(s:String,maxLetters:Int,minSize:Int,maxSize:Int):Int{val frequency=IntArray(26);var left=0;var distinct=0;var answer=0;val counts=mutableMapOf<String,Int>();for(right in s.indices){if(frequency[s[right]-'a']++==0)distinct++;if(right-left+1>minSize){if(--frequency[s[left++]-'a']==0)distinct--};if(right-left+1==minSize&&distinct<=maxLetters){val value=s.substring(left,right+1);val count=(counts[value]?:0)+1;counts[value]=count;answer=maxOf(answer,count)}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxFreq(string s,int maxLetters,int minSize,int maxSize){int frequency[26]={},left=0,distinct=0,answer=0;unordered_map<string,int> counts;for(int right=0;right<(int)s.size();++right){if(!frequency[s[right]-'a']++)++distinct;if(right-left+1>minSize)if(!--frequency[s[left++]-'a'])--distinct;if(right-left+1==minSize&&distinct<=maxLetters)answer=max(answer,++counts[s.substr(left,minSize)]);}return answer;} };
